item.title: CVE-2026-82356 — Imprivata EAM: Unrotatable X.509 RSA Key Pair in Production
item.description: Imprivata EAM <=26.2.6 lacks the ability to rotate its RSA key pair after deployment when generating an X.509 certificate. Using an RSA key pair indefinitely for certificate generation is against best practices.
